evals.prompt: Our GLB has Idle, Walk, and Wave clips. Blend from idle to walk, play wave once, then return to idle without frame-rate-dependent motion.
evals.expected_output: An AnimationMixer-based approach using named actions, delta-time updates, cross-fades, finished handling, and cleanup.
assertions: Uses one AnimationMixer for the animated root and updates it with delta seconds
Looks up named clips rather than relying on unstable array positions
Handles one-shot completion and mixer teardown
